# Security Policy

## Supported versions

Only the latest version deployed from the `main` branch is supported.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please report suspected vulnerabilities through
[GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/xirzec/link-cleaner/security/advisories/new).
Do not include sensitive vulnerability or exploit details in a public issue.

Include the affected behavior, reproduction steps, impact, browser details when
relevant, and any suggested mitigation. Reports will be reviewed and addressed as
soon as practical.
